content.title: Morgan Stanley Climbs Debt Rankings as Go-To Bank for AI Bonanza
content.summary: The firm has led or co-led some $65 billion in corporate bond deals for data centers or other AI investments since October, more than any other large US bank, according to data compiled by Bloomberg.  The bank’s AI effort — and a strategic push into debt capital markets — has helped Morgan Stanley increase its share in arranging US investment grade bond deals.
